messages:
rachel: heads-up: runtime team asked for a 45m pin to runtime=4.2 for model_group=summary-pro to validate a byte-alignment fix that changed embedding offsets. proposing staging probe first.

deploy-bot: proposed action: pin runtime=4.2 scope=hosted duration=45m requestor=rachel reason='embedding offset alignment fix verification'

sam: runtime note: weights are compatible but byte alignment alters float packing, small embedding norm drift possible. recommend strict embedding-sim checks and an auto-unpin.

ops: ops will approve for us-east-staging only with rollback criteria: >0.6% increase in 5xx or top-10 recall drop >0.003. auto-unpin must be configured.

sre-oncall: i'll add alerts and a dashboard panel. query preview: `avg_over_time(embedding_cosine_drop[10m])` + `sum(rate(errors[5m]))/sum(rate(reqs[5m]))`. link when ready.

docs: draft short customer note: "Temporary routing to runtime 4.2 for summary-pro canary; slight embedding variance possible — reindex guidance included if needed."

rachel: approvals: runtime+ops? then i'll start 4% canary in us-east-staging.

ops: approved for us-east-staging. runtime approved conditionally after local sanity run.

rachel: starting canary at 3712345685 -> canary_traffic=4%

deploy-bot: action: pinned runtime=4.2 for model_group=summary-pro in us-east-staging at 3712345685

sre-oncall: 12m snapshot: embedding cosine drop avg 0.0009, errors +0.05%. within thresholds. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/sum-pro-4.2-canary

sam: running synthetic top-k recall; no regression above threshold. good so far.

rachel: expanding to 30% in us-east-staging at 3712345730.

deploy-bot: action: expand canary -> us-east-staging=30% at 3712345730

ops: one host logged transient mem pressure; autoscale recovered. continuing.

sre-oncall: 30m check: metrics stable. enabling auto-unpin on breach: `/deploybot set-auto-unpin --thread=3712345678 --on-failure=true --targets=us-east-staging`

docs: finalizing changelog entry. will publish after global decision.

rachel: canary passed in staging. planning global rollout in maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. will open PR for hotfix branch if we need quick revert. thanks all :white_check_mark:
